stories.title: Trevor Roush to Seek Democratic Nomination for Pine Plains Town Supervisor
stories.source: The New Pine Plains Herald (Patrick Grego)
stories.summary: Farmer and Stissing grad Roush wants meetings above the library, open office hours.
stories.headline: A STISSING GRAD WHO FARMS RAN FOR SUPERVISOR
stories.line: Roush graduated from Stissing Mountain High, farms in town, and wanted board meetings moved above the library.

stories.title: Brian Walsh Seeks Reelection as Pine Plains Supervisor
stories.source: The New Pine Plains Herald (Patrick Grego)
stories.summary: Walsh sought a fourth term; won 2025 by eight votes after a hand recount.
stories.headline: WALSH WON BY 8 VOTES LAST YEAR, AFTER A HAND RECOUNT
stories.line: Supervisor since 2022 and a school maintenance worker, Walsh ran on a downtown sidewalk plan and said the $4.5M Town Hall was unaffordable.

stories.title: Stanford Town Board Appoints Nathan Lavertue to One-Year Term
stories.source: The New Pine Plains Herald (Patrick Grego)
stories.summary: Board unanimously appointed him January 8 to the seat Julia Descoteaux vacated.
stories.headline: THE BOARD APPOINTED LAVERTUE. VOTERS JUST ELECTED HIM.
stories.line: Appointed unanimously on Jan. 8 to the seat left when Julia Descoteaux became supervisor.
